name: @personal-api/e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests: load the built extension (and the Spike A prototype) in bundled Chromium; Spike C runs on Firefox through Selenium + geckodriver.

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @personal-api/contracts build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/rules build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/api build && pnpm --filter extension build:firefox && playwright test --config playwright.firefox.config.ts extension-smoke-firefox extension-harness-firefox extension-pairing-firefox extension-sync-firefox extension-rules-firefox extension-restart-flush-firefox
scripts.test:e2e:firefox:spike: pnpm --filter @personal-api/spike-mv3-lifecycle build && playwright test --config playwright.firefox.config.ts spike-mv3-firefox
scripts.test:e2e:edge: pnpm --filter @personal-api/contracts build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/rules build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/api build && pnpm --filter extension build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/spike-mv3-lifecycle build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:edge:smoke: pnpm --filter @personal-api/contracts build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/rules build && pnpm --filter @personal-api/api build && pnpm --filter extension build && playwright test --grep @smoke
